Trim · Cape Cod, MA

Exterior trim repair, done right at the edges.

Rot repair, fascia and soffits, corner boards and window trim — with clean lines, tight joints, and a clear estimate. Free on-site visit.

Get a free estimate (508) 566-1618

Why it matters

Trim is your home's first line of defense.

On a Cape Cod house, trim takes the first hit from wind-driven rain and salt air. Leaks start at the corners, seams, and transitions — and once moisture gets behind a board, it quietly softens the framing underneath.

That's why we don't just nail new boards over old problems. We open it up, fix what's underneath, and then install trim that's fitted, fastened, and sealed to last.

  • Stops water at corners, seams and transitions
  • Prevents hidden rot from reaching the framing
  • Protects fascia and soffits from constant moisture
  • Closes gaps that let insects and animals in
  • Helps paint and siding last longer

Scope

What we handle

  • Fascia

    Rotted or soft fascia boards replaced and properly backed.

  • Soffits & vents

    Damaged soffits repaired with vent paths kept clear.

  • Window & door trim

    Casings, sills and head trim fitted tight around openings.

  • Corner boards

    Vertical seams and corners rebuilt square and sealed.

  • Frieze & rake boards

    Top edges and roofline transitions made weather-tight.

  • Interior finish trim

    Baseboards, casings and detailed interior finishing.

Trim problems spread fast

Watch for peeling paint, dark staining, soft spots, and gaps at corners or rooflines. Catching it early usually means a smaller, simpler repair.

FAQ

Trim questions, answered.

Do you offer free on-site trim estimates?

Yes. We visit, inspect fascia, soffits, corners and windows, and give you an itemized scope and estimate.

Do you do repairs, or only full replacement?

Both. We repair what's still sound and replace when that's the safer long-term fix — and we'll explain why.

What trim materials do you use?

Common exterior materials used on the Cape, including wood and PVC. We recommend based on exposure, budget and look.

Do you repair fascia and soffits too?

Yes. They're some of the most common failure points in coastal weather.

How long does a trim project take?

It depends on how many areas need work and whether there's hidden rot. You'll get a timeline after the visit.
